test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 23 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined words in the given sentence.

__By definition, making a pictogram__ is to present and visualise data.

options.text: To make a pictogram by definition
In making a pictogram, the definition

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"purpose"** refers to the reason for which something is done, created, or exists. It reflects the intent or goal behind an action or object. (उद्देश्य)

 
 
• **Example: **The purpose of the meeting is to discuss the project’s progress.
 
 
 
• **Definition** refers to a statement that explains the meaning of a word, phrase, or concept. (परिभाषा)
 
 
• **Example: **The definition of a triangle is a three-sided polygon.
 
 
 
• Hence, the appropriate substitution for the underlined words in the sentence is **"The purpose of a pictogram."**

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: "To make a pictogram by definition"** (परिभाषा के अनुसार पिक्टोग्राम बनाना): This phrase is grammatically incorrect and does not convey the intended meaning.

 
 
• **Example:** This option cannot be used appropriately in the given context.
 
 
 
• **Option 2: "Pictogram is making a definition"** (पिक्टोग्राम एक परिभाषा बना रहा है): This option is incorrect as it misrepresents the meaning of the sentence.
 
 
• **Example:** This sentence is not logically coherent.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: "In making a pictogram, the definition"** (पिक्टोग्राम बनाने में, परिभाषा): This option is incomplete and does not make sense in the context of the sentence.
 
 
• **Example:** This phrase does not convey a complete thought.
